// ADR-284 §7a acceptance set — kanban rebuilt in the builder, generated by packages/shared/src/codeView/generate.ts.
// Golden output of apps/builder/src/preview/catalog/__tests__/adr284CodeView.test.tsx (UPDATE_CODE_VIEW=1 rewrites).

import {GridList, GridListItem, Text} from 'react-aria-components';
import {useListData} from 'react-aria-components/useListData';
import {isTextDropItem, useDragAndDrop} from 'react-aria-components/useDragAndDrop';
import ticketsData from './data/tickets';

export default function Home() {
  let tickets = useListData({
    initialItems: ticketsData,
    getKey: item => item.id
  });
  let items = tickets.items;
  let itemsStatusCountRows = items;
  let itemsStatusCountGroups = Map.groupBy(itemsStatusCountRows, item => item.status);
  let itemsStatusCount = [...new Set(tickets.items.map(item => item.status))].map(status => [status, itemsStatusCountGroups.get(status) ?? []]).map(([status, rows]) => ({id: status, status: status, count: rows.length}));
  let itemsOpen = items
    .filter(item =>
      item.status === 'Open');
  let itemsInProgress = items
    .filter(item =>
      item.status === 'In Progress');
  let itemsClosed = items
    .filter(item =>
      item.status === 'Closed');
  let {dragAndDropHooks: gridListDragAndDrop} = useDragAndDrop({
    getItems: keys => [...keys].map(key => ({'tickets': String(key)})),
    acceptedDragTypes: ['tickets'],
    getDropOperation: () => 'move',
    async onInsert(e) {
      let keys = await Promise.all(e.items.filter(isTextDropItem).map(item => item.getText('tickets')));
      for (let id of keys) tickets.update(id, {...tickets.getItem(id), status: 'Open'});
      if (e.target.dropPosition === 'before') tickets.moveBefore(e.target.key, keys);
      else if (e.target.dropPosition === 'after') tickets.moveAfter(e.target.key, keys);
    },
    async onRootDrop(e) {
      let keys = await Promise.all(e.items.filter(isTextDropItem).map(item => item.getText('tickets')));
      for (let id of keys) tickets.update(id, {...tickets.getItem(id), status: 'Open'});
    },
    onReorder(e) {
      if (e.target.dropPosition === 'before') tickets.moveBefore(e.target.key, e.keys);
      else if (e.target.dropPosition === 'after') tickets.moveAfter(e.target.key, e.keys);
    },
  });
  let {dragAndDropHooks: gridList2DragAndDrop} = useDragAndDrop({
    getItems: keys => [...keys].map(key => ({'tickets': String(key)})),
    acceptedDragTypes: ['tickets'],
    getDropOperation: () => 'move',
    async onInsert(e) {
      let keys = await Promise.all(e.items.filter(isTextDropItem).map(item => item.getText('tickets')));
      for (let id of keys) tickets.update(id, {...tickets.getItem(id), status: 'In Progress'});
      if (e.target.dropPosition === 'before') tickets.moveBefore(e.target.key, keys);
      else if (e.target.dropPosition === 'after') tickets.moveAfter(e.target.key, keys);
    },
    async onRootDrop(e) {
      let keys = await Promise.all(e.items.filter(isTextDropItem).map(item => item.getText('tickets')));
      for (let id of keys) tickets.update(id, {...tickets.getItem(id), status: 'In Progress'});
    },
    onReorder(e) {
      if (e.target.dropPosition === 'before') tickets.moveBefore(e.target.key, e.keys);
      else if (e.target.dropPosition === 'after') tickets.moveAfter(e.target.key, e.keys);
    },
  });
  let {dragAndDropHooks: gridList3DragAndDrop} = useDragAndDrop({
    getItems: keys => [...keys].map(key => ({'tickets': String(key)})),
    acceptedDragTypes: ['tickets'],
    getDropOperation: () => 'move',
    async onInsert(e) {
      let keys = await Promise.all(e.items.filter(isTextDropItem).map(item => item.getText('tickets')));
      for (let id of keys) tickets.update(id, {...tickets.getItem(id), status: 'Closed'});
      if (e.target.dropPosition === 'before') tickets.moveBefore(e.target.key, keys);
      else if (e.target.dropPosition === 'after') tickets.moveAfter(e.target.key, keys);
    },
    async onRootDrop(e) {
      let keys = await Promise.all(e.items.filter(isTextDropItem).map(item => item.getText('tickets')));
      for (let id of keys) tickets.update(id, {...tickets.getItem(id), status: 'Closed'});
    },
    onReorder(e) {
      if (e.target.dropPosition === 'before') tickets.moveBefore(e.target.key, e.keys);
      else if (e.target.dropPosition === 'after') tickets.moveAfter(e.target.key, e.keys);
    },
  });

  return (
    <>
      <div>
        <div>
          <Text>{`Open · ${itemsStatusCount.find(row => row.id === 'Open')?.count ?? ''}`}</Text>
          <GridList dragAndDropHooks={gridListDragAndDrop} items={itemsOpen}>
            {item => <GridListItem id={item.id} textValue={String(item.id)}>{item.id}</GridListItem>}
          </GridList>
        </div>
        <div>
          <Text>{`In Progress · ${itemsStatusCount.find(row => row.id === 'In Progress')?.count ?? ''}`}</Text>
          <GridList dragAndDropHooks={gridList2DragAndDrop} items={itemsInProgress}>
            {item => <GridListItem id={item.id} textValue={String(item.id)}>{item.id}</GridListItem>}
          </GridList>
        </div>
        <div>
          <Text>{`Closed · ${itemsStatusCount.find(row => row.id === 'Closed')?.count ?? ''}`}</Text>
          <GridList dragAndDropHooks={gridList3DragAndDrop} items={itemsClosed}>
            {item => <GridListItem id={item.id} textValue={String(item.id)}>{item.id}</GridListItem>}
          </GridList>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
